However, in reality she is worried about the fact that she still hasn't apologized, and doesn't want to completely lose her relationship with him. She has a complex about her small breasts, which Kousuke likes to tease her about. In exchange, Karen often kicks him with so much force that it actually stuns him. And because Karen has attended all-girls' schools all throughout her life, she is quite sensitive to the smell of men.
